html:
The Birrbay, also spelt Birpai or Biripi, are an Aboriginal Australian people of the mid north coast of New South Wales, around today's Port Macquarie and the Hastings and Manning rivers.

They share a dialect chain, the Gathang language, with the Worimi to the south. Other neighbours were the Dainggatti to the north and the Geawegal and Nganyaywana inland.

In 1821 the British opened a penal settlement at Port Macquarie for convicts who reoffended. Cedar cutters and settlers followed when the district was opened up in the 1830s.
sum: The Birrbay, also spelt Birpai or Biripi, are an Aboriginal Australian people of the mid north coast of New South Wales, around today's Port Macquarie and the Hastings and Manning rivers.
